author: nocapsnonumbers
body: We need the old nexus maps back, or at least bigger ones, because at the moment it's just a cluster of people attacking anyone, and the best kill stealer gets all the kills. I'm not good at stealing so my KD has gone from 5 to 3.5 and also it's no fun at all. Nexus should have a smaller player limit, this will stop all this player cluster because a bigger map and less people means more of just 1v1's or 2v2's and things rather than 6v6's. Less people will also mean less FPS lag for people like me and others with awful PC's.

replies.author: Refisio
replies.body:
As a matter of fact, it does matter.

Back when we had only one favorable Nexus map (the one with the two beaches, the giant complex, and the bridges underneath) and no Nebula gamemode, I had an insane 3.0 K/D because of the way I was able to play. With the new maps (and, therefore, lack of the old ones), there are less ways to play, which makes overall gameplay not as good as something like Nebula, where you're forced to find a different way to break the objective every time.
